title: DOW-UAP-D28, Mission Report, Iraq, September 2024
doc_notes: This is a declassified Department of War mission report (MISREP) regarding an armed overwatch flight in Iraq; while it mentions an Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) incident, the event is described as a sensor anomaly/high-speed object detection rather than a close-range encounter with entities or physical traces, and thus no encounter records were generated.
